text:
kelsey: Heads-up: live-fire window next Tue 9-11 PT. Need RBAC toggle plan + KMS telemetry/evidence handoff. Who can own the orchestration? Also want audit log sampling to match assessor scope. cc @aj @maria

aj: I can own RBAC toggles. Quick Q: do we want ephemeral roles via `assessor-ephemeral` or precreated `assessor-group`? Prefer ephemeral for least blast radius.

maria: Agree ephemeral. We'll create an AWS STS-based role with 1h expiry. I'll draft the policy. Do we need presigned S3 upload for evidence or SCP to an audit bucket?

sam: Presigned S3 upload is easiest for testers. We should also stream CloudTrail -> Splunk short-term retention for the window. I'll put together the KMS key grant pattern.

security-bot: Reminder: Must attach ticket in the runbook and approve before window. https://redwood.tools/runbooks/live-fire

aj: Policy sketch (put in #ops later):

```
- Effect: Allow
- Action: sts:AssumeRole
- Resource: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessor-ephemeral
- Condition: aws:RequestTag/assessor_window == "1749991111"
```

We will rotate the key policy post-window.

maria: KMS note: use grant with `CryptographicOperations` only, avoid giving kms:Decrypt to testers. We'll generate a temporary CMK key-id for the audit bucket and record grant tokens.

kelsey: Can someone propose the audit log sampling query? Need to capture `AssumeRole`, `GetObject` from S3, and any `StartSession` calls.

sam: I can. Splunk query draft:
```
index=infra sourcetype=cloudtrail eventName IN (AssumeRole, GetObject, StartSession) | stats count by userIdentity.arn, eventName
```
We'll tag events with `assessor_window:1749991111`

aj: Ops checklist to be added: (1) create role & policy, (2) provision presigned upload, (3) create KMS grant, (4) enable Splunk tag, (5) smoke test with a dummy assessor account, (6) notify assessor.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll own steps 1 & 3. Sam can you do 4 & 5? @aj cover 2 & 6.

sam: Yep. I'll schedule a 30-min dry run Fri 10am PT. Link: <https://zoom.redwood/12345|dry-run>

kelsey: Great. Also, if toggles fail, fallback is to abort and collect evidence via live syslog export. Add to runbook: `abort -> snapshot -> revoke-grants`

security-bot: Action required: create ticket SEC-8421 and assign to kelsey for runbook updates.

aj: Created SEC-8421. Added checklist and owner assignments.

maria: One more: ensure presigned URL expires 24h after window and is single-use. Use `x-amz-meta-assessor-id` tag.

kelsey: Perfect. Last call: any compliance asks? @compliance-team?

sam: Pinged compliance DM. They asked for retention policy: keep assessor evidence 90 days in audit bucket.

kelsey: Noted. I'll update the runbook and post final checklist tomorrow. Thanks everyone :pray:
